text:
```yaml
name: Spellcheck

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  spellcheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          override: true

      - name: Install typos
        run: cargo install typos

      - name: Run typos spellchecker
        run: typos
```
